lae_prison_01b.m: Please open the other cells and free us all! Hurry! Then come back to me.

lae_prison_02a.m: The prison torturer died, but he took the life force of us prisoners in the hope to live again.

lae_prison_02b.m: It didn't work, because we had so little life left anyway.

lae_prison_02c.m: But now we cannot rest in peace, because he is still here, somewhere in the lower caves. He needs to be destroyed, but we cannot do it because he has control over us.
r: OK. I'll do it. I am not afraid of a few monsters!
No thanks. Seems dangerous, and there's nothing in it for me.

lae_prison_03.m: Thank you! But beware! He has guards that are like him. They may appear to be human at first glance, but they are not!

lae_prison_3a.m: Ohhh! What will become of us?

lae_prison_end_10.m: Oh, the kid is back. Just look!
r: You can finally find peace. Kotheses, the torturer is dead.

lae_prison_end_30.m: Everything is in order now. The prisoners are back in their cells, and the Demon guards are on duty again.

laeroth_nondisplay.13: Raised the spirit of cuned again
laeroth_nondisplay.102: Inside the Laeroth barn basement, the PC has found the Mystery Laeroth key.

laeroth_nondisplay.105: I gave Gylew the Korhald chest.
laeroth_nondisplay.106: This is just a wrapper around the odd coin collector "end" steps as there are 4 of them, it is easier to check this one when looking for confirmation that the quest is complete.
laeroth_nondisplay.107: Sold 5 bronze and 5 silver coins to the coin collector.

lae_torturer.5: In the dungeon of the mansion I found some ghosts of prisoners. One of them told me their story.
lae_torturer.10: I have agreed to help the spirits in the prison be free of the prison torturer.
lae_torturer.20: I didn't want to help the spirits in the prison be free of the prison torturer.
lae_torturer.25: Kotheses the torturer offered to teach me his art, as he had done for Andor before.
lae_torturer.30: I accepted his offer to apprentice with him.
lae_torturer.35: Kotheses gave me an Oegyth crystal.
lae_torturer.40: In order to imprison the released prisoners again, I should call the demon guard by throwing an Oegyth crystal into the abyss.
lae_torturer.50: Kotheses scolded me because I killed his precious demons.
lae_torturer.60: I declined the offer to become his apprentice.
lae_torturer.80: I told the prisoners that I had killed their torturer. Now they could get peace.
lae_torturer.100: I have thrown an Oegyth crystal down into the abyss to call for the dark watch.
lae_torturer.110: I got back the Oegyth crystal from the chief of the Demon guard.
lae_torturer.114: I ordered the demons to watch over the prisoners.
lae_torturer.120: I took my leave from Kotheses, who, incidentally, forgot to reclaim his Oegyth crystal.
lae_torturer.130: Everything was in order when I left. The prisoners were back in their cells, and the Demon guard were on duty again.
